sourceSet.name: House Skills
sourceSet.description: Repo-backed decision/import manifest for Harley's first-party House Skills set after the MARK-9 sanity rollup. MARK-16 imports the first two reviewed full skill source records while leaving the wider manifest as decision metadata for later slices.

issueLineage.title: Import first-party GPT custom skills into the asset marketplace
Add House Skills plugin marketplace skeleton
Import Linear and Codex dispatch House Skills
Import base doctrine and work-mode House Skills

statusVocabulary.v1: Accepted as a stable versioned House Skill candidate for later source import, subject to the recorded modification notes and normal validation.
statusVocabulary.v0.1: Accepted as useful and bundleable but provisional; later import must preserve the known caveats instead of presenting it as v1-ready.
statusVocabulary.fold: Do not import as a standalone skill; move the surviving value into the named destination doctrine, workflow, skill, or project surface.
statusVocabulary.retire: Do not import or revive as active installable skill content; keep only provenance/history or explicitly named residue.
statusVocabulary.reference-only: Keep as evidence or system/context reference only; do not import into House Skills as active skill content.
statusVocabulary.defer: Out of the current House Skills import slice; preserve the parked question or future owner without claiming active import readiness.

pluginPosture.projectionPolicy: House Skills source decisions live under sources/gpt-skills provenance first. Codex plugin projections may later bundle reviewed skills without forcing one permanent bundle boundary.
pluginPosture.currentSourceImportBoundary: MARK-17 imports exactly three additional reviewed base/work-mode source records: gpt-base-doctrine-v1, work-mode-router-v1, and worker-readiness-prep-v1. No plugin projection is added in this slice.

globalDecisions.decision: skill-creator is system-built-in/reference-only and is not imported as a House Skill.
skill-market retires because MARK replaces the old marketplace route; useful installability/candidate-review residue folds into MARK source-intake and marketplace doctrine.
Standalone GitHub issue-management and GitHub operations skills retire. Linear is the issue/control-plane surface; GitHub is ordinary evidence/tool surface only.
worker-readiness-gate is a gate inside worker-readiness-prep, not a standalone top-level House Skill in this manifest.
Generic/base source partitioning probably belongs in TPS unless implementation proves residue.
Deck, PPTX, and receipt surfaces are outside this House Skills import; bin/defer them rather than carrying them as active House Skills.

cleanup-custody-v0.1 is the accepted public House Skills rename for the installed profanity-bearing cleanup skill. The original name remains provenance/history only and the public name must not imply a pure buster.
For repo/code work, PRs are the normal worker work packet. Readiness, dispatch, validation, and GitHub proof doctrine should not preserve old direct-main/prove-on-main assumptions.

Linear/Codex dispatch must preserve the observed working delegation mechanics: Codex Cloud work needs both the responsible human assignee and a distinct Codex delegate; the human remains accountable, and coding work must not be delegated to the Linear agent.
agentDistinctions: The Codex delegate is distinct from the Linear agent.
The Linear agent/tool context may mutate or read Linear state, but it is not the coding worker.
Do not delegate coding work to the Linear agent.

verificationRequirement.requiredAction: After any assignment/delegation mutation, re-fetch the issue and verify observable Linear state before claiming dispatch.
successEvidence: issue shows the expected human assignee
status moved to Todo or In Progress as appropriate
Codex activity appears on the issue
a PR attachment appears on the issue

globalDecisions.toolStabilityGuidance: If GitHub connector binding causes Linear mutation or verification instability, prefer a Linear-only connector/tool context before retrying assignment/delegation; do not keep blind-retrying unstable mixed-tool calls.
globalDecisions.source: MARK-15 codifies the live MARK-13/MARK-14 Linear/Codex dispatch lesson as decision metadata only.

globalDecisions.decision: Cross-project base doctrine must carry the boring-first posture: exciting things are made possible by boring-first workflows, evidence, repeatability, validation, and risk reduction.

MARK-16 imports exactly two reviewed House Skills source records: linear-v1 and worker-dispatch-linear-v1. No other House Skill source text is imported and no Codex plugin bundle skill projection is added in this slice.

MARK-17 imports exactly three reviewed base/work-mode House Skills source records: gpt-base-doctrine-v1, work-mode-router-v1, and worker-readiness-prep-v1. Worker-readiness-gate-v1 remains folded into worker-readiness-prep-v1 and is not imported as a standalone top-level skill. No unrelated House Skills and no Codex plugin bundle projections are imported in this slice.

skillDecisions.name: work-mode-router-v1
skillDecisions.decisionSummary: Imported as the GPT-wide work-mode router that replaces old bootstrap confusion, classifies requests into the smallest sufficient mode, and routes normal coding work through worker-readiness-prep-v1 and worker-dispatch-linear-v1 instead of legacy chat/YAML dispatch stacks.

skillDecisions.name: worker-readiness-prep-v1
skillDecisions.decisionSummary: Imported as the replacement for old broad dispatch-prep language. It prepares executable worker handoffs through durable lawful lanes and owns the folded worker-readiness-gate behavior internally.
skillDecisions.containsGate: worker-readiness-gate-v1 behavior is folded inside this prep workflow rather than imported as a standalone top-level skill here.

skillDecisions.name: worker-readiness-gate-v1
skillDecisions.decisionSummary: Valuable gate behavior is preserved inside imported worker-readiness-prep-v1, not as a standalone top-level House Skill.

skillDecisions.name: linear-v1
skillDecisions.decisionSummary: Renamed/reframed successor to old linear-control-plane. Imported as the Linear connector-mechanics and durable working-state skill, with coding dispatch routed to worker-dispatch-linear-v1 and MARK-15 human-assignee plus Codex-delegate mechanics preserved.

delegationMechanics.retryPosture: If mixed GitHub/Linear connector context is unstable, switch to a Linear-only connector/tool context before retrying instead of blind retrying.

skillDecisions.name: worker-dispatch-linear-v1
skillDecisions.decisionSummary: Renamed/reframed successor to old linear-codex-dispatch. Imported as the narrow Linear-based worker dispatch/control-plane skill for Linear handoff, Codex worker routing through Linear, worker status, PR gate, PR iteration, merge-readiness routing, and verified human-assignee plus Codex-delegate mechanics.

delegationMechanics.retryPosture: If mixed GitHub/Linear connector context is unstable, switch to a Linear-only connector/tool context before retrying instead of blind retrying.
